---
name: first-issue-pack
description: Create implementation-ready starter issues for VenturaRobo from the approved simulation-first MVP and Beta gates. Use when maintainers need small independent tasks that move the scaffold toward a reproducible prototype. Do not use when requirements are undefined or the issue would require unsafe physical actuation.
---

# First issue pack

- Read the current simulation scope and repository state first.
- Create one verifiable outcome per issue.
- Include simulation fixture expected behavior and safety boundary when relevant.
- Separate planning perception ROS integration tests and documentation work when independent.
- Keep each issue suitable for one focused pull request.
- Mark dependencies explicitly and keep physical-hardware work out until safety prerequisites exist.
